text:
Diego S (Eng): heads up - I'm expecting a kid in June and planning parental leave starting 2024-06-03 for 12 weeks. planning to use 6 weeks paid Redwood leave + 6 weeks unpaid. question: will my contractor interview panel need to change availability? also curious about the return-to-work performance check-in process.
Taylor R (People Ops): congrats! you'll be eligible for Redwood paid leave per policy. for interviews, loop hiring-ops and your interview schedulers to reassign panels temporarily. @Hiring Ops can automagically re-route invites.
Hiring Ops: we can do that. share the list of panels and tentative blackout window and we'll reassign. we keep a centralized panel pool for streams to avoid churn.
Diego S (Eng): thanks. on the perf check-in  what's typical for a 12-week leave return? do we schedule ramp-up meetings or re-evals?
Taylor R (People Ops): typical process: manager-led 30/60/90 check-ins focusing on priorities and capacity. People Ops offers an optional return-to-work plan template and a one-time phased-week schedule (up to 6 weeks) if you want gradual ramp. There's no formal performance penalty; any changes to role or expectations should be documented and discussed.
Diego S (Eng): perfect. payroll Q: can I elect to use accruals to cover the unpaid weeks? i have 80h PTO.
payroll-bot: you can request PTO top-up via the "Leave Payment Election" form. options:
```
- Apply PTO to unpaid weeks (up to accrual balance)
- Convert PTO to caregiver stipend (one-time, see separate form)
- Save accruals for future PTO
```
payroll-bot: note  PTO used to cover unpaid weeks reduces accrual balance and affects payout on termination. Also confirm tax implications with Benefits Team.
Benefits Team: FSA grace rules  if you lose coverage or change elections during leave, talk to benefits. Also parental leave does not change your performance review timing unless manager requests a change.
Diego S (Eng): how do parental leaves interact with promotion cycles? my review is scheduled for late July while I'll be on leave.
Taylor R (People Ops): typical options: manager can (1) keep review date and include contributions up to leave start, (2) pause review until return, or (3) do an interim calibration with limited data. we recommend discussing with your manager; People Ops can document the agreed approach.
Diego S (Eng): forwarding to manager now. thanks folks.
Taylor R (People Ops): ne zuc  we'll help with the panel reassignments and return check-in template.
Diego S (Eng): submitted Leave Payment Election to apply 40h of PTO to the unpaid portion. thanks.
